title: Great tour! Loved skipping the line!
text: Our tour guide, Tony, was very knowledgeable. We loved that he led us around the crowds and provided a lot of insights into the park and its creation and history. He also gave us some time to explore and take photos while making recomendations for how to spend time in the park after the tour and for local nearby attractions.
